video_title: Tuomas Iisalo Press Conference | Grizzlies vs. Hornets

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Cedric Henderson's role and ball-handling responsibilities in the first unit
quotes.excerpt: Cedric's not in an easy spot playing in that we know that the ball is a lot in Ty's hands
quotes.quote: Cedric's not in an easy spot playing in that we know that the ball is a lot in Ty's hands with that first unit and a lot of times the connector in those situations is then Booz, who we go to a lot also with the ATOs and different type of stuff.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo discusses the offensive hierarchy for the Grizzlies first unit noting that while Ty Jerome dominates the ball Cedric Henderson and Booz are key connectors in their sets

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Edey's development and offensive role within the team
quotes.excerpt: we also want to get him more involved as others need to adjust playing with him
quotes.quote: Zach's we also want to get him more involved as others need to adjust playing with him and on him I can say that the others are doing a much better job passing the ball into areas where only he has access. And also Zach's been really good with his discipline and looking to get deep catches and if he doesn't have that he's going to kick it out, make the next play or turn it into an offensive rebound.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo says the team is improving at feeding Zach Edey in the post noting that Edey has been disciplined about getting deep catches or making the right play when the look is not there

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Ty Jerome's resilience and growth as a full-time point guard
quotes.excerpt: he's a very mentally extremely strong player with a ton of confidence
quotes.quote: He's a very mentally extremely strong player with a ton of confidence. So if you would tell him that he struggled, he'd say, no, I just missed some shots. So he shakes that off very fast and he's a very, very good offensive player. And you know that basketball is a game of runs. There will be some up and downs, but he stays with his process.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo praises Ty Jerome for his mental toughness and confidence saying the guard shakes off missed shots quickly and stays committed to his process

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: The team's defensive progress and commitment to rebounding
quotes.excerpt: better to have tired legs and good habits than bad habits and fresh legs
quotes.quote: The stuff that I said in the locker room and also said to the coaches is something we've said over the years: better to have tired legs and good habits than bad habits and fresh legs. The amount of work the guys have been putting in, you see the level of execution really pick up, the communication, the physicality.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo emphasizes the importance of building good habits over rest noting that the team is seeing better execution and physicality as a result of their work

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: The team's ongoing development and long-term building process
quotes.excerpt: there are no quick wins. You can only do a lot of damage in the short term
quotes.quote: There are no illusions, this is preseason. Teams play guys maybe a half, maybe three quarters, maybe three and a half quarters. Wednesday when we start the season then it's going to be very different and we have to keep that mindset that we keep improving. In the NBA, there are no quick wins. You can only do a lot of damage in the short term. You got to build things up in the long term while maintaining this type of sense of urgency.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo warns against reading too much into preseason results stating that in the NBA there are no quick wins and the focus must remain on long term building

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: The effectiveness of two-point guard lineups and team depth
quotes.excerpt: I like the fact that we have a ton of handlers even in the first unit
quotes.quote: I like the fact that we have a ton of handlers even in the first unit. You can say that Sed or Booz, they're both very good handlers for their positions and especially Booz for a four man, he's essentially a second playmaker. I feel like that's just the direction basketball has gone to. You need several playmakers and a lot of our triggers or actions or sets are built so that we have two handlers.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo explains his preference for lineups with multiple playmakers saying the modern game requires several handlers to run their offensive sets effectively

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Murray's role and defensive impact in the starting lineup
quotes.excerpt: we wanted to see him also there together with the starters
quotes.quote: We wanted to see him also there together with the starters. We've had him with some of the bench units and this game presented a good opportunity with that with Brandon Miller being one of the best scoring wings in the whole league. I thought he did a tremendous job with what we say arriving with the ball, not fouling and being there on every catch, closing out, closing the and really made his life difficult.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo credits Chris Murray for his defensive effort against Brandon Miller saying Murray did a tremendous job arriving with the ball and making life difficult for the scorer
